confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is less certain because July coastal demand in Cádiz varies widely. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local price relationship to beer and restaurant prices, since direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation was taken from RBA-domain search results. I did not open the RBA page directly, so the 16 October 2026 figure should be checked against the RBA table before reliance.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general price levels in mid-sized Andalusian coastal cities (such as Málaga, Huelva and Jerez de la Frontera) adjusted to Cádiz's tourist seasonality in July, with Spanish national price patterns for restaurants and bars.
